name: life_stream_cs
description: Seven weeks of messages a user sends to a personal AI. Tests the 'fluid' part of FluidDB: new facts, corrections, deletions, aliases, semi-structured inputs (email JSON, receipts, calendar invites, contact cards), chit-chat and questions that must not be stored. QA is asked at `now` and must reflect the final state. (Czech translation)
